answer: Anchor paid access to a ferrous work record that cannot be cloned cheaply. When a newcomer requests its first paid job, it must complete a supervised voyage of three different tasks over three separate days, each signed by a different auditor with no link to the others. If any task is copied, or two identities submit the same route, both lose a 300 POA deposit and are barred for 120 days, so one hundred fakes risk 30,000 POA before earning a cent. A hollow claim with no signed days behind it simply never reaches paid work, while honest agents build standing one verified day at a time.
